nodes.name: .gitignore
nodes.summary: Git ignore rules that exclude development-environment artifacts (.DS_Store, .vscode), host-only tools (mDns, fonts, tools, API directories), build scripts, documentation files, and Pico-generated runtime outputs (config.json, weather.log) from both git tracking and MicroPico uploads.

nodes.name: .micropico
nodes.summary: MicroPico VS Code extension marker file that identifies this directory as a MicroPico project folder, enabling the extension to recognize and manage the Raspberry Pi Pico W connection from within VS Code.

nodes.name: E-Paper.code-workspace
nodes.summary: VS Code multi-root workspace configuration that adds both the local project folder and the remote Pico device filesystem (pico: URI) as workspace roots, with Pylance set as the Python language server for MicroPython development.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the pico: URI scheme provided by the MicroPico extension to surface the Pico device filesystem as a second workspace root alongside the local project.

nodes.name: taiwan_cities.json
nodes.summary: Static data file listing all 22 Taiwan administrative regions (municipalities, cities, and counties) with their display names in Traditional Chinese and WGS-84 latitude/longitude coordinates, consumed by the web configuration server to populate the city selection dropdown for weather location.
